title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: coap_oscore.c:337 stack buffer CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE (stack, not static) in lichen_coap_oscore_respond for every error path
description: lichen_coap_oscore_respond at coap_oscore.c:337 allocates `uint8_t buf[CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE]` on the stack. This is used for every OSCORE-protected error response (4.00, 4.29, 5.00, etc.). On constrained devices (STM32WL: 64KB RAM), a 1KB+ stack allocation in every error path is wasteful. All other respond functions use static buffers. Consider making this static to match the project pattern.
